body: W3 implementation checkpoint (isolated worktree only; no shared source edits): the chief-approved one-line interview.dependsOn(embedCore) edge resolves and compiles on JVM/JS/Native, confirming no JVM-only dependency leaks into interview. InterviewSuite passes 25/25 on JVM, JS, Native. This is an intermediate design-level diff, not a candidate: the split/detector evidence remains correctly sequenced behind M1's corrected P0-2 phase 2. Requested its private SHA; privacy.scala remains free to M1.
